examples.chinese: 從下個月起，飛機票就變貴了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng xià gè yuè qǐ, fēijī piào jiù biàn guì le.
examples.english: Starting from next month, plane tickets will become more expensive.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 我請旅行社代訂從台北直飛美國的班機，機票較貴，但能節省不少時間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qǐng lǚxíngshè dài dìng cóng Táiběi zhífēi Měiguó de bānjī, jīpiào jiào guì, dàn néng jiéshěng bùshǎo shíjiān.
examples.english: I asked the travel agency to book a flight from Taipei directly to the US; the ticket is more expensive, but it can save quite a bit of time.

examples.chinese: 這個影片介紹了亞洲的飲食文化。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yǐngpiàn jièshào le Yàzhōu de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: This video introduced Asia's food culture.

examples.chinese: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.
examples.english: With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games.

examples.chinese: 有一些網路上的資料或影片是被保護的，不能隨便下載。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē wǎnglù shàng de zīliào huò yǐngpiàn shì bèi bǎohù de, bùnéng suíbiàn xiàzài.
examples.english: Some materials or videos on the internet are protected and cannot be downloaded casually.

examples.chinese: 這個角色一直找不到合適的演員，幸好那位明星點頭答應演出，否則影片就拍不成了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège juésè yīzhí zhǎo bù dào héshì de yǎnyuán, xìngkuī nà wèi míngxīng diǎntóu dāyìng yǎnchū, fǒuzé yǐngpiàn jiù pāi bù chéng le.
examples.english: They couldn't find a suitable actor for this role all along; fortunately, that celebrity nodded and agreed to perform, otherwise the film couldn't have been made.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 我奶奶不會用電腦，每次想跟朋友連絡，不是去郵局寄信就是打家裡的電話。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai bú huì yòng diànnǎo, měi cì xiǎng gēn péngyǒu liánluò, bú shì qù yóujú jì xìn jiù shì dǎ jiālǐ de diànhuà.
examples.english: My grandmother doesn't know how to use a computer. Every time she wants to contact her friends, she either goes to the post office to mail a letter or calls the home phone.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 在國外遇見好久沒聯絡的好友，是一件很開心的事情。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài yùjiàn hǎojiǔ méi liánluò de hǎoyǒu, shì yī jiàn hěn kāixīn de shìqing.
examples.english: Meeting a good friend you haven't contacted for a long time abroad is a very happy thing.

examples.chinese: 你想參加這項長跑比賽的話，可以到網站報名，登記之後會有人跟你聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng cānjiā zhè xiàng chángpǎo bǐsài de huà, kěyǐ dào wǎngzhàn bàomíng, dēngjì zhīhòu huì yǒu rén gēn nǐ liánluò.
examples.english: If you want to participate in this long-distance race, you can sign up on the website; after you register, someone will contact you.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: A:要是你發現男朋友對你越來越冷淡，還常跟女網友約會， 你會原諒他嗎？ B:這麼花心的男人，絕對不值得原諒。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàoshi nǐ fāxiàn nánpéngyou duì nǐ yuèláiyuè lěngdàn, hái cháng gēn nǚ wǎngyǒu yuēhuì, nǐ huì yuánliàng tā ma? B: Zhème huāxīn de nánrén, juéduì bù zhídé yuánliàng.
examples.english: A: If you found out that your boyfriend was becoming colder and colder toward you and often went on dates with female internet friends, would you forgive him? B: A man who is such a playboy is absolutely not worth forgiving.

items.wordHook: Combining 冷(cold) and 淡(light): 冷淡 means cold, frigid.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 我雖然尊敬他，卻不認同他所堅持的觀點。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ suīrán zūnjìng tā, què bù rèntóng tā suǒ jiānchí de guāndiǎn.
examples.english: Although I respect him, I do not approve of the viewpoint he insists on.

examples.chinese: 這件事大家都堅持自己的觀點，討論不出結果，還是找個說話有分量的人來決定吧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā dōu jiānchí zìjǐ de guāndiǎn, tǎolùn bù chū jiéguǒ, háishì zhǎo gè shuōhuà yǒu fènliàng de rén lái juédìng ba.
examples.english: In this matter, everyone insists on their own viewpoint, and no result can be reached through discussion; it would be better to find someone whose words carry weight to decide.

items.wordHook: Viewing 觀(observe) scenery at this designated 點(point): 觀點 means viewpoint.

examples.chinese: 用過一面的紙張別急著丟，另一面也可以用。
examples.pinyin: Yòng guò yī miàn de zhǐzhāng bié jízhe diū, lìng yī miàn yě kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: Don't rush to throw away paper that has been used on one side; the other side can also be used.

examples.chinese: 這道菜味道獨特，香味及顏色也很迷人，讓人忍不住流口水。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài wèidào dútè, xiāngwèi jí yánsè yě hěn mírén, ràng rén rěnbuzhù liú kǒushuǐ.
examples.english: This dish has a unique flavor, and its aroma and color are also very charming, making people unable to resist drooling.

examples.chinese: 他今天忙得不得了，連喝一口水的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān máng de bùdéliǎo, lián hē yī kǒu shuǐ de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: He is incredibly busy today; he doesn't even have time for a single mouthful of water.

items.wordHook: a 宀(roof) rests over 肖(resemble) shadows → the late 宵(night).
A sharp 殳(tool) chops a fallen tree trunk into one distinct, manageable 段(section).
Combining 領(withdraw money) and 域(area): 領域 means field.
風(wind) + 景(scenery): the scenery shaped by wind.
